fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal affairs, including criticism of the bus agreement and subsidies involving the Florida Power & Light Company, discussion of city finances and taxation (including reminders to pay poll tax and register), and commentary on tourism and price changes after the boom. Local columns and satire cover Miami and Miami Beach social life and entertainment, with notices and advertisements for theaters and events; items also mention Bayfront Park lighting and travel across the causeway.
